text: This solution, National Volcanic Hazard and Risk Model (NVHRM) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Toka Tū Ake Natural Hazards Commission, National Emergency Management Agency/MCDEM, DPMC, Treasury, MFAT, LINZ, MBIE, local government and CDEM groups, MetService, DOC, NZ Lifelines Council, iwi and Iwi Leaders Forum, University of Auckland, University of Canterbury, and World Bank GFDRR. The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
